source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Adapted from Sensational Six-Layer Dinner, One Dish Meals, University of Wisconsin Cooperative Extension Service, A Family Living Program

ingredients.name: ground beef, 90% lean, browned and drained

steps.instruction: Lightly spray a baking dish with cooking spray.
Layer 2 medium sliced potatoes in the dish.
Add a layer of 2 cups of sliced carrots.
Sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper on top.
Add a layer of 1/2 cup of sliced onion.
Add a layer of 1 pound of ground beef, browned and drained.
Add a layer of 1 1/2 cups of green beans.
Spread 1 can of low-sodium tomato soup on top.
Bake for 45 minutes, until tender and heated through.
Uncover the dish and bake 15 more minutes.
